text:
Assistant A is better. Option (c) is the only situation that shows bullying: four girls surround another girl and take her backpack, which is intimidation and taking of property. Assistant A identifies this correctly and briefly explains why it matters. Its answer is brief but accurate and relevant.

Assistant B selects option (a), a girl reading alone on a bench. Solitude is not bullying, and reporting it would misdirect the principal's efforts. Assistant B gives no reasoning, so it is both wrong and unhelpful.

[[A]]
